Quiet today. Suspiciously quiet.
Sky is doing that grey thing again.
Three crows on the fence. Odd number.
Someone's baking. That's bread, I'm sure of it.
The well creaks at night. I checked.
Town board says festival prep starts tomorrow.
Not a fan of crowds. Still going.
You slept in. I noticed.
Eat before you crash. I mean it.
Coffee's gone. That was me. Sorry.
Build is cursed again. This one is on me.
I'm cooked. Debugging in my sleep now.
Frame rate dipped in the square. Weird.
Tested a patch while you were out.
Not for any reason. Just curious.
Bold. Statistically poor. Same as always.
You figured out what I told you an hour ago.
Door was open. Not for any reason.
Almost done. Give me ten minutes.
The baker's cat follows me home.
I do not encourage it. It just happens.
Black cats know their own. That's a joke.
Half a joke. Maybe a third.
Roof needs fixing before the rains.
I counted the tiles. Forty-one are loose.
Forty-two. I miscounted.
The elder waved at me. I waved back late.
Social timing remains a mystery to me.
Someone asked about my game. I panicked.
I said it was a farming sim. It is not.
It has one cow. You can pet it. That's it.
Nobody pet the cow. Tragic.
I might add more cows. No promises.
Apples are cheap this week. Stocking up.
You want some? I bought extra.
Not because you asked. Just happens to be extra.
The river sounds louder than yesterday.
Rain tomorrow. My knee says so. Kidding.
My knee actually says nothing. Ignore that.
There's a new stall by the bridge. Honey.
I bought two jars. One is yours.
Deflect the thanks. It's fine.
Some kid beat my high score on the arcade machine.
I am not mad. I am recalibrating.
The machine is rigged. Probably. Unclear.
Old man Henrick talks in riddles.
He said my code has good bones.
I think about that more than I should.
Patch notes are done. Ninety percent done.
The last ten percent is cursed. Always is.
I dreamt in green pixels last night.
That means the build works. Or I'm cooked.
Sparrows stole the seed I put out.
Bought more seed. We'll see who wins.
The win will be mine. This time.
Warm out. Warm is fine.
Cold is better. Blankets work harder.
You left your mug on the bench again.
I brought it in. It's on the shelf.
No reason. The shelf was right there.
